answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The pulse edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 133 clones produces a signature the island analysis flags immediately. Anyone must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the raven settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 14 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
